children.game_version: A 'follow the leader' game in a half-circle where the leader controls the speed.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the arm movements at shoulder level while seated, focusing on heel taps.
seniors.standing_version: Hold onto a support for balance while performing the steady steps and heel movements.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Maintain a consistent, slower tempo throughout.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Hands held up at shoulder level.
movement_profile.footwork: Steady steps on the whole foot.
movement_profile.partnering: Mixed-gender, holding hands in a line.
movement_profile.posture: Upright with hands held at shoulder level.

signature_moves.description: A characteristic movement of the heels performed while stepping.
signature_moves.name: Heel movement

music_profile.sound_description: The music follows a 2/4 rhythm that supports a steady pace, which gradually speeds up toward the end of the dance.

basic_steps: Establish a half-circle formation with hands held at shoulder level.
Perform steady steps on the whole foot.
Gradually increase the tempo of the steps as the dance progresses.
teaching.level_notes: Beginner-friendly due to steady footwork, but requires attention to tempo changes.
